title: Per-record writes instead of batched operations
summary: Saving or updating records one at a time can create excessive database round trips and transaction overhead.
rationale: Ruby and Rails code often favors simple per-record loops, but bulk operations are much more efficient for imports, migrations, and background jobs.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large collections, high-traffic Rails actions, background jobs, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Use insert_all, upsert_all, update_all, transactions, batching, or database-native bulk operations when callbacks/validations are not required per record.
remediation.tradeoffs: May require refactoring for readability, query shape, or framework conventions.
